name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Quality (Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version: [20.19, 22]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.33.4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Check lint and formatting
        run: pnpm check

      - name: Check TypeScript
        run: pnpm type-check

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Test Bun compatibility
        if: matrix.node-version == 22
        run: pnpm --filter run test:bun

name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - ".changeset/**"
      - ".github/workflows/release.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release:
    if: github.repository == 'vercel-labs/run'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320 # v5

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Create release PR or publish packages
        uses: changesets/action@63a615b9cd06ba9a3e6d13796c7fbcb080a60a0b # v1
        with:
          version: pnpm ci:version
          publish: pnpm ci:release
          setupGitUser: false
          commitMode: github-api
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

{
  "name": "run-workspace",
  "private": true,
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.33.4",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "turbo run build",
    "build:packages": "turbo build --filter=run",
    "changeset": "changeset",
    "check": "pnpm --filter run check && oxfmt --check content/docs",
    "ci:release": "pnpm build:packages && changeset publish",
    "ci:version": "changeset version && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile",
    "fix": "pnpm --filter run fix && oxfmt content/docs",
    "test": "pnpm --filter run test",
    "test:watch": "pnpm --filter run test:watch",
    "type-check": "pnpm --filter run type-check"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@changesets/cli": "^2.31.1",
    "oxfmt": "^0.41.0",
    "tsx": "^4.23.5",
    "turbo": "^2.10.8"
  }
}

{
  "name": "run",
  "version": "2.1.10",
  "description": "Secure QuickJS-backed JavaScript runtime with host functions and continuations",
  "keywords": [
    "javascript",
    "quickjs",
    "runtime",
    "sandbox",
    "workers"
  ],
  "type": "module",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "sideEffects": false,
  "main": "./dist/index.js",
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/index.js",
      "default": "./dist/index.js"
    }
  },
  "files": [
    "dist/**/*",
    "LICENSE",
    "README.md",
    "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "pnpm clean && tsup --tsconfig tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/embed-inline-worker.mjs",
    "build:watch": "node scripts/build-watch.mjs",
    "check": "pnpm lint:banned && ultracite check",
    "clean": "del-cli dist *.tsbuildinfo",
    "fix": "ultracite fix",
    "type-check": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/tsconfig.json",
    "test": "pnpm test:node && pnpm test:package",
    "test:bun": "pnpm build && bun scripts/bun-smoke.mjs && bun --bun vitest --run && bun --bun vitest --mode package --run",
    "test:hardening": "pnpm test:package",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "test:node": "vitest --run",
    "test:package": "pnpm build && vitest --mode package --run",
    "hardening:fuzz": "pnpm build && node scripts/hardening-fuzz.mjs",
    "hardening:soak": "pnpm build && node --expose-gc scripts/hardening-soak.mjs",
    "lint:banned": "node scripts/check-banned-patterns.js",
    "benchmark": "pnpm build && node scripts/benchmark.mjs",
    "verify:dependencies": "node scripts/verify-dependencies.mjs",
    "verify:embedded-worker": "node scripts/verify-embedded-worker.mjs",
    "verify:package": "pnpm build && pnpm type-check && node scripts/verify-embedded-worker.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs",
    "prepack": "node scripts/verify-embedded-worker.mjs"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "22.19.19",
    "del-cli": "^7.0.0",
    "devalue": "5.8.2",
    "esbuild": "^0.28.1",
    "oxfmt": "^0.41.0",
    "oxlint": "^1.56.0",
    "quickjs-wasi": "3.6.3",
    "tsup": "^8.5.1",
    "typescript": "5.8.3",
    "ultracite": "7.3.2",
    "vitest": "^4.1.6"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "typescript": ">=5.1.6 <7"
  },
  "peerDependenciesMeta": {
    "typescript": {
      "optional": true
    }
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.19.0"
  },
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/vercel-labs/run/tree/main/packages/run#readme",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/vercel-labs/run.git",
    "directory": "packages/run"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/vercel-labs/run/issues"
  }
}

# run

`run` executes untrusted JavaScript and type-stripped TypeScript in a hardened QuickJS sandbox. Guest code can access only the host functions you provide. ## Quick start ```sh pnpm add run ``` Supports Node.js 22.13 or newer and Bun. ```ts import { run } from 'run'; const result = await run({ source: ` const orders = await store.listOrders('customer_123'); return orders.reduce((total, order) => total + order.amount, 0); `, hostFunctions: { store: { listOrders: (customerId: string) => database.orders.findMany({ customerId }), }, }, }); if (result.status === 'completed') { console.log(result.value); } ``` The generated program can call `store.listOrders()`, while the database client and its credentials stay in your application. ## Features - Every invocation gets a fresh QuickJS context in a worker thread, with no ambient Node.js, filesystem, module, or network access. - A host function can interrupt a run for approval or authentication. The run resumes without repeating host calls that already completed. - Time, memory, result size, and concurrency are capped, per run or per runner. `run` is for sandboxed JavaScript computation inside an application. Workloads that need an operating system, package installation, or process-level isolation should use Vercel Sandbox. ## Documentation Start with the [introduction](content/docs/introduction/index.mdx), then the [foundations](content/docs/foundations/overview.mdx) and the [API reference](content/docs/reference/index.mdx). ## Development `pnpm test:watch` runs tests directly against TypeScript source, including the embedded worker and guest serialization code. Source edits rerun affected tests without a package build or a `dist` directory. Use `pnpm --filter run test:node` for a single source test run. `pnpm test` runs the source suite, then builds and runs the full suite against the shipped worker bundle, including hardening and package distribution tests. `pnpm --filter run test:package` (also `test:hardening`) runs this build-backed suite directly. Bare `vitest` commands use the source setup; `--mode package` selects the built worker and requires a package build first. `pnpm check` runs formatting, static analysis, and the fail-closed banned-pattern security scan. A local `@banned-pattern-ignore` is accepted only when it states a concrete safety reason and suppresses an actual finding; stale suppressions fail the scan. ## License [Apache 2.0](LICENSE)
